result.rationale: In zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts, the axios call is wrapped in refreshOAuthTokens. When sharing is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response (per refreshOAuthTokens.ts), not an axios response, so the subsequent `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` accesses a non-existent .data property on a Response and throws TypeError.

judged_text: In sharing mode tokenInfo is a fetch Response with no .data property, so tokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError. Every Zoho Bigin calendar operation with sharing enabled crashes at "if (!tokenInfo.data.error)" instead of refreshing the token.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode tokenInfo is a fetch Response with no .data property, so tokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError. Every Zoho Bigin calendar operation with sharing enabled crashes at "if (!tokenInfo.data.error)" instead of refreshing the token.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is now obtained via `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. That helper returns a `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). A `Response` does not have an Axios-style `.data` property, but the Zoho Bigin code still does `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`, which will throw a TypeError in sharing mode. This matches the finding.
